name: mpu_region_configure

provenance.source: manual review of the exact 3.100.043 IDB (EVID-STATIC-P65-002)

notes: manual static-test accept 2026-10-25 (EVID-STATIC-P65-002): Five-argument BES MPU configure(region<=7, base 32-aligned, size>0x1F, access<=5, lock): validates, computes RBAR/RLAR and writes them through 0xc9665a0 (RNR 0xE000ED98, RBAR 0xE000ED9C, RLAR 0xE000EDA0) under an IRQ mask. This is the exact ABI the staged Supervisor calls; the sibling 0xc9666b0 is mpu_setup(base,size,access,mode), which allocates its own region first. Restricted/PENDING; device NOT_PROBED.
